name: ChopShop
description:
## About ChopShop

ChopShop is a complete B2C e-commerce platform designed to help vendors of all sizes sell online and deliver to their customers efficiently.

### For Vendors

Set up your online store in minutes. Manage products, track orders, and grow your business with powerful analytics.

### For Customers

Browse products, place orders, and track deliveries — all from a beautifully designed app that matches your favorite store's brand.

### For Delivery

Optimized routing, real-time tracking, and seamless handoff make deliveries efficient and transparent for everyone involved.

## Ready to Launch Your Store?

Get in touch to see how ChopShop can power your online retail business.

hero.title: آپ کی دکان، ہر جگہ
hero.subtitle: Vendors کے لیے مکمل B2C shopping platform۔

features.title: Vendor Storefront Management
features.description: Each vendor gets their own customizable storefront with product listings, categories, inventory management, and sales analytics.

features.title: Custom-Branded Customer App
features.description: White-label mobile app that matches your brand. Customers browse, search, add to cart, and checkout seamlessly.

features.title: Delivery App & Tracking
features.description: Dedicated delivery driver app with route optimization, real-time tracking, and delivery confirmation.

features.title: Payment Processing
features.description: Secure payment gateway integration supporting multiple payment methods including cards, mobile wallets, and cash on delivery.

features.title: Order Management
features.description: Complete order lifecycle management from placement to delivery. Real-time status updates for vendors, customers, and drivers.

features.title: Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Comprehensive analytics for vendors and platform admins. Track sales, popular products, customer behavior, and delivery metrics.

faq.question: What platforms does ChopShop support?
faq.answer: ChopShop includes a web admin panel, iOS and Android customer apps, and a dedicated delivery driver app.

faq.question: Can I customize the customer-facing app with my branding?
faq.answer: Yes! ChopShop is fully white-label. You can customize colors, logos, fonts, and the overall look to match your brand identity.

faq.question: How does the delivery system work?
faq.answer: Drivers receive orders through the dedicated delivery app, get optimized routes, and customers can track their delivery in real-time.

faq.question: What payment methods are supported?
faq.answer: We support credit/debit cards, mobile wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), bank transfers, and cash on delivery.
